summary_en: 190M shares (2.7% S/O), ¥300B limit. Public tender: ¥150B limit (to be announced separately); open-market purchase: balance of ¥300B less tender amount. Period: 4 Aug 2026–29 Jan 2027. Price ceiling not disclosed. Supports stated ¥300B+ buyback target for FY3/27.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares; Public Tender Offer and Open-Market Purchase of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 3 August 2026, ITOCHU's board resolved to acquire up to 190 million ordinary shares (2.7% of issued shares excluding treasury) for an aggregate ceiling of ¥300 billion during the period 4 August 2026 through 29 January 2027. The company intends to execute up to ¥150 billion of this amount via public tender offer (details to be disclosed separately) and the remaining amount via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange after the tender period closes. No price ceiling was disclosed in this notice. The acquisition implements ITOCHU's capital-allocation strategy centered on dividends (current: ¥42/share for FY3/26), total shareholder return target of 40%+, and progressive dividends. The company publicly disclosed in May 2026 its plan to execute ¥300 billion or more in treasury-share acquisitions during FY3/27 (year ending 31 March 2027); this board resolution operationalizes that commitment. The company has historically executed treasury acquisitions via market purchases and off-market trades since 2022, with the most recent program (announced 6 February 2026) completing purchase of 9.5 million shares by 24 March 2026.
